derivation: middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G5087 (τίθημι);
def: to place before, i.e. (for oneself) to exhibit; (to oneself) to propose (determine)

occurrences.text: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
